purpose: This silver table cleans the bronze ourairports_runways capture into a typed, deduplicated runway reference table keyed on id, feeding downstream airport and runway analytics.
usage: Consumers should join on id for runway-level facts and on airport_ref to the airports dimension; latitude, longitude, elevation, heading, and displaced-threshold columns for both runway ends are frequently null (22%-90% null rates) and must be handled as optional geodata, not assumed present.
limitations: No exact duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied; displaced-threshold fields are over 88% null and heading/position fields are 22%-28% null, so analyses depending on complete runway-end geometry will be missing most rows and should filter or aggregate accordingly.
